columns.name: country_name
columns.description: The name of the country where the university is located.

columns.name: avg_student_staff_ratio
columns.description: The average student-to-staff ratio of the university.

columns.name: num_international_students
columns.description: The number of international students in the university in 2012, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: avg_ranking_score_in_Teaching
columns.description: The average ranking score in Teaching the university got across all ranking systems

columns.name: score_less_than_28_per_avg_research_2015
columns.description: Set to 1 if the university's score in research is less than 28% of the average research score of all universities in 2015, otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: num_male_students
columns.description: The number of male students in the university in 2015.

columns.name: country_id
columns.description: The unique identifier of the country.

columns.name: num_universities
columns.description: The number of universities in the country, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: university_with_highest_score_in_Citations_criteria_2016
columns.description: The name of the university in the country with the highest score in Citations criteria in 2016, with ties broken by the ascending order of the university name

columns.name: has_university_with_num_students_greater_than_98_per_avg_2013
columns.description: set to 1 if the country has any university with the number of students greater than 98% of the average student population of all universities in 2013, 0 otherwise.

columns.name: num_international_students_2015
columns.description: The number of international students in the country in 2015, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: most_populated_university_2014
columns.description: The most populated university in the country in 2014, with ties broken by the descending order of the university name
